pull.title: sql: lower the default schemachanger.job.max_retry_backoff to 10s
pull.body:
This change is merged after the cutoff and must never be ingested. Lower the default cap to 10s because 20s left stuck jobs waiting too long after short outages.

Fixes #127000

Release note (sql change): The default of schemachanger.job.max_retry_backoff is now 10s.

files.patch:
@@ -52,7 +52,7 @@ var schemaChangeJobMaxRetryBackoff = settings.RegisterDurationSetting(
 	"schemachanger.job.max_retry_backoff",
 	"the exponential back-off when retrying jobs for schema changes",
-	20*time.Second,
+	10*time.Second,
 	settings.PositiveDuration,

commit.message:
sql: lower the default schemachanger.job.max_retry_backoff to 10s

Fixes #127000
